preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.

edition-and-house-style.instruction: Identify the edition and editorial scope; record explicit house-style decisions and conflicts.

verify-applicable-passage.instruction: Apply an attributed book rule only after reading its relevant passage, including qualifications; otherwise mark it unverified.

consistent-decisions.instruction: Apply a verified editorial decision consistently to editable prose while preserving quotations, code, citations, and intentional exceptions.

bounded-attribution.instruction: Separate verified source-based changes, user house-style choices, and unresolved questions in an optional audit.
